description: Implementation of BackendService interface for managing orders, roles, products, and users in an e-commerce backend system.

classes.name: BackendServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for backend management operations including orders, roles, products, and users.

methods.name: filteredOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders filtered by status.

methods.name: getPageInfoResponseVo
methods.description: Constructs a paginated response object containing order details and associated items.

methods.name: buildOrderVo
methods.description: Builds an OrderVo object from Order and its associated OrderItems.

methods.name: customerOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders for a specific user.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Adds a new role based on provided RoleForm.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates an existing role based on provided RoleForm.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product based on ProductAddForm.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product based on ProductUpdateForm.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user profile information by username.
